The eighth public release candidate of the NPMplus Security Fork, for test servers ahead of a stable release. It replaces RC7.

### Action required

Update an existing RC7 test VM before its next maintenance window. The installer is now v1.59 and its daily heal migrates a seeded fail-open CrowdSec bouncer config to the fail-closed posture on the next run; opt out once with `touch /data/crowdsec/keep-fail-open`. Nothing else is manual - the TOTP replay migration runs on its own.

### Security

- Closed ten audit findings across the permission model and the CrowdSec integration.
- A delegated manager can no longer attach another user's access list by guessing its id, and permission checks now fail closed on malformed input.
- Unix-socket and custom upstream destinations are administrators-only, and upstream addresses that are not plain addresses are rejected from delegated managers.
- CrowdSec fails closed end to end: the image seeds `MODE=stream` with `APPSEC_FAILURE_ACTION=deny`, the daily heal reopens the public gate only after the firewall bouncer is enforcing, and two silent fail-open paths under `deny` are closed - an AppSec outage served the ban page as HTTP 200, and `deny` without `FALLBACK_REMEDIATION` let every request through.
- TOTP codes are single-use, including under concurrent logins, and existing enrollments keep their secrets. Access-list usernames containing htpasswd delimiters or control characters are rejected.

### Changed

- The CrowdSec dashboard's **Attackers** view is now the default: paginated source-IP groups, search, and an investigation drawer whose evidence loads on demand. See the [investigation guidance](https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/blob/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.8/docs/attacker-investigation.md).
- Reconciled upstream `develop`: certificate ids a caller cannot see are rejected on create and update, and new non-admin users default to `hidden`.
- Updated dependencies: nginx 1.31.6 and aws-lc v5.9.0; other bumps are held to the 7-day maturity gate.

### Fixed

- Minor CrowdSec dashboard fixes: bouncer identity, stable LAPI error responses, notification dedupe, refresh and pager buttons, the ASN filter chips, repeated log lines, and a switched-off observation source reporting `disabled` instead of `unavailable`.

### Upgrade

Copy and paste the complete command:

```bash
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.8/setup-npmplus.sh &&
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.8/setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sha256sum -c setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sudo bash setup-npmplus.sh
```

Choose **Install NPMplus** for a fresh test VM or **Safe update** for an existing installer-managed one. Safe update repairs known configuration drift before the normal snapshot, health check, and automatic rollback protection.

Please report problems through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/issues). Report security vulnerabilities privately through the repository Security page.
